dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam! I'm in Chiang Mai. What a lovely day!
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm! aɪm ɪn ˈtʃjɑːŋ ˈmaɪ. ˈwʌt ə ˈlʌvli ˈdeɪ!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: It's sunny and cool, and the sky is so clear.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈsʌni ənd ˈkuːl, ənd ðə ˈskaɪ ɪz ˈsoʊ ˈklɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: How nice! It's hot and humid in Bangkok.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈnaɪs! ɪts ˈhɑːt ənd ˈhjuːmɪd ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And I love the fresh air here. The mornings are very pleasant.
dialogue.reading: ənd aɪ ˈlʌv ðə ˈfrɛʃ ˈɛr ˈhɪr. ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋz ər ˈvɛri ˈplɛzənt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Come here with me next December!
dialogue.reading: ˈkʌm ˈhɪr wɪð miː ˈnɛkst dɪˈsɛmbər!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: OK! Take a lot of photos for me!
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ! ˈteɪk ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfoʊtoʊz fər miː!
